standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 1118-1119 as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the closed case from which the general case is assembled.

core_obligations: Construct the map: from the canonical map of the functor to the identity the proof obtains by base change a map from the base change of the derived sections with support to the base change of the complex, and observes that its source has cohomology supported in the inverse image of the support, so the map of the statement exists (proof lines 1114-1117)
Closed case: if the support is closed, the map is an isomorphism by the base change statement of the chapter on dualizing complexes (proof lines 1118-1119)

General case: both sides are rewritten as filtered colimits over the closed subsets contained in the support, the inverse image turning one directed system into the other, and the map is an isomorphism termwise because the base change of a flat map commutes with filtered colimits and has no higher Tor (proof lines 1120-1127)

The bounded case: the hypothesis of finite dimension on both rings is the condition under which the local cohomology of an unbounded complex still vanishes in high degrees, giving the second assertion (proof line 1109-1110)
proof_roadmap: 先造映射：RΓ_T(K) → K 作 base change 得 RΓ_T(K) ⊗^L_A B → K ⊗^L_A B，其源的 cohomology 支撑在 T' = T 的原像内，故得到引理中的箭头。
T 闭时由 dualizing 章的 base change 引理得同构；一般情形把两边写成 T 内闭子集上的滤过 colim（用 lemma-adjoint-ext），原像把一个有向系统送到另一个，而平坦基变换与滤过 colim 交换且无高阶 Tor，故逐项同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement asserts that for a flat map of Noetherian rings the base change of the derived sections with support in a specialization-stable subset is the derived sections with support in its inverse image, for bounded below complexes, and for all complexes when both rings have finite dimension (author lemma at source lines 1098-1111, label lemma-torsion-change-rings). The proof (source lines 1113-1128) first constructs the arrow and checks that its source is supported in the inverse image, then disposes of the case of a closed support by the base change statement of the chapter on dualizing complexes, and finally reduces the general support to that case by expressing the local cohomology with support in a general subset as a filtered colimit over the closed subsets it contains, as recalled in the context span; flatness makes the base change commute with these colimits (proof lines 1120-1127). The colimit reduction to the closed case is the content. H2.
